pages.text: Unlocking Hamon in your skill tree, or reading a $(item)Basic Hamon Book$(), teaches the $(bold)Hermit Path$(), which nobody taught.$(br2)Every other path comes from a $(item)Path Book$(). Use one to learn its path.
Path Books lie in $(place)stronghold libraries, woodland mansions, pillager outposts, desert and jungle temples$(), and $(place)dungeons$().

The paths you walk decide which techniques you can learn. There are eight:$(li)Hermit$(li)Warrior$(li)Wisdom$(li)Defender$(li)Envious$(li)Trickster$(li)Prideful$(li)Stylish$(br2)$(warn)The dead cannot read the books.$()
